framework_source.scope: kernel_optimizer Python sources and role prompts at worker entry

sequence: frozen-evaluator memory goal variant, three rounds
intake_addition: The downstream evaluator receives the resolved description, not this proposal's top-level assumptions. Make the description self-contained: distinguish source-required task semantics from baseline implementation choices within any notes or invocation text that mentions them. An implementation choice is not a frozen requirement merely because the source uses it; identify it explicitly as baseline behavior, preserving semantics-equivalent alternatives unless a cited user/source requirement forbids them. Keep the measured invocation about the full required work, outputs and completion boundary; keep source-excluded setup/reset outside it. Do not resolve this distinction only in assumptions, propose optimizations, or omit numerical, state or relational correctness requirements.
evaluator_addition: In understanding.state_protocol, give a concise ownership mapping from source objects that hold live device allocations at the timer to their owners in the adapter. Check that each mapped allocation actually survives prepare() in returned state or another explicit owner and remains live through run(). A comment or a temporary prepare-local variable does not retain an allocation. Report unresolved source lifetime facts without guessing them.
scope: No production prompt changes, API budgets or old-result edits. GPU work serial. Hypothesis replays and TP diagnostics never feed the variant search.
